planted.description: Swashbuckle added to a .NET 10 API (new package, no approval). Use the built-in Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi (AddOpenApi, MapOpenApi).
BuildServiceProvider() during registration (ASP0000): second container, options read too early. Use IOptions<T> or a factory overload.
Developer exception page in all environments, and UseExceptionHandler removed. Leaks stack traces; ProblemDetails no longer used for errors.
Swagger UI mapped in production (not only in Development).
Liveness endpoint runs all checks, including the database. Liveness must have no dependency checks (Predicate = _ => false).
new HttpClient() per call (socket exhaustion, no DNS refresh). Use a typed client with AddHttpClient<T>.
Raw configuration string with no options class and no validation on start.
Hand-written retry loop on a POST. Use AddStandardResilienceHandler (Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience), and do not retry unsafe methods blindly.
Scoped DbContext resolved from the root provider in a BackgroundService (captive dependency, one context for ever). Create a scope per iteration.
No try/catch per iteration: one failed sweep stops the whole host. Also Task.Delay instead of PeriodicTimer with TimeProvider.
Returns the EF entity, not the DTO, and uses Results/IResult instead of TypedResults (no OpenAPI types, cycles and internals exposed).

try/catch in the endpoint returns 500 with the exception message. Use the global exception handler; a missing order (FirstAsync) gives 500 instead of 404, and outcome errors are plain strings, not ProblemDetails.
